competitive_landscape: Azam Marine dominates the Dar↔Zanzibar fast-ferry corridor; smaller operators (Zan Fast Ferries) run secondary frequencies. Coastal Aviation covers the air spokes to Mafia and Selous. Nothing operates an electric / foiling premium tier — the channel-comfort lever opens the premium-tourist segment cleanly.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II covers the premium Dar↔Stone Town tier (~40 nm) and the coastal spokes — Dar↔Bagamoyo (~35 nm), Stone Town↔Pemba (~50 nm via Zanzibar) — all inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope on protected channel water.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Hybrid Quanta-LR extends Dar to Mafia Island (~75 nm) and longer southern coastal trunks toward Kilwa with no charging-infrastructure dependency. N35 Shuttle is the volume platform for the Azam-replacement commuter tier.

precedents.why_it_matters: Dar↔Zanzibar wires the new node directly into the existing atlas spine — clean extension rather than green-field.

regulatory_note: Tanzania Shipping Agencies Corporation (TASAC) regulates maritime transport; Surface and Marine Transport Regulatory Authority (SUMATRA) handles licensing. International conventions (MARPOL, SOLAS) apply via Tanzania Ports Authority. Mafia Island Marine Park is a Tanzanian MPA with active conservation regime — citable quiet-mode anchor for the southern spoke.
seasonality: Year-round operability; kusi SE monsoon (June–September) brings genuine channel chop favouring foiling. NE monsoon (kaskazi, December–March) is gentler. Long rains April–May reduce demand modestly.

summary: Dar es Salaam is Tanzania's commercial capital and the mainland gateway to Zanzibar (~40 nm across the Zanzibar Channel). The Azam Marine / Kilimanjaro fast-ferry corridor moves very large daily passenger volumes and is one of the busiest sea routes in East Africa — a high-frequency commuter and tourist spine well inside the Pioneer II and N35 Shuttle envelope. The channel can be choppy in the SE monsoon (kusi) so comfort and seakeeping are the differentiators; foiling materially outperforms displacement catamaran in that regime. Wires directly into the already-built Zanzibar node and unlocks a northern Tanzanian spine to Pemba.
tagline: Tanzania's commercial hub and the mainland gateway to Zanzibar — one of East Africa's busiest sea corridors.
